title: Scotch Egg with Umami Glaze
description: A twist on the classic scotch egg with an umami-rich glaze, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Boil a pot of water and cook the scotch egg for 10-12 minutes, or until it's cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the vegan mayonnaise, vegan mustard, and smoked paprika.
In a separate bowl, mix the umami glaze ingredients.
Once the scotch egg is cooked, slice it in half lengthwise.
Brush the umami glaze over the scotch egg, then drizzle with the vegan mayonnaise mixture.
Note: For the umami glaze, you can use a combination of ingredients such as soy sauce, miso paste, and maple syrup.
